fullPassage: Have you ever seen rows of identical fruit or vegetables in the supermarket? They may look pretty, but consider this — perfectly fine produce that looks a little different is being wasted. In fact, some farmers end up throwing away as much as 50 percent of their harvest because it doesn't look quite right. Fortunately, this is beginning to change. All of this wasted produce tastes just as good as what they sell in the supermarket. So there are now some organizations that buy ugly produce from farmers and sell it to consumers at prices as much as 30 percent lower than normal. Not only does this practice benefit farmers and consumers, but it also helps protect the environment, since farmers don't have to waste resources growing unwanted produce.

② producer: 생산자 — 만드는 사람
③ investor: 투자자 — 돈을 투자하는 사람
④ manager: 관리자 — 운영·관리하는 사람
det.tip: buys and uses goods(상품을 사서 씀) → consumer(소비자)

questions.passage: In fact, some farmers end up throwing away as much as 50 percent of their harvest because it doesn't look quite right. __________ (fortunate), this is beginning to change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: fortunate(형용사: 다행인) → Fortunately(부사: 다행스럽게도). 문장 전체를 꾸미는 부사 자리
det.analysis: 형용사 fortunate를 부사 Fortunately로 바꿔요. 문장 맨 앞에서 콤마로 이어지며 문장 전체를 꾸미는 자리는 부사 자리예요. 형용사에 -ly를 붙이면 부사가 돼요. 'Fortunately, ~' = '다행스럽게도, ~'.
det.tip: 형용사 + -ly = 부사 → fortunate → Fortunately (문장 전체 수식)

questions.passage: All of this wasted produce tastes just as good as what they sell in the supermarket. So there are now some organizations that buy ugly produce from farmers and sell it to __________ (consume) at prices as much as 30 percent lower than normal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: consume(동사: 소비하다) → consumers(명사: 소비자들). '~에게 팔다'의 대상 자리, 여럿이므로 복수
det.analysis: 동사 consume을 사람 명사 consumers로 바꿔요. 'sell it to __________(~에게 팔다)'에서 전치사 to 뒤는 파는 대상, 즉 사람 명사 자리예요. 동사 consume에 -er을 붙이면 '소비하는 사람(consumer)', 여러 명이므로 -s를 붙여 복수형 consumers가 돼요.
det.tip: 동사 consume + -er(s) = 소비자들(consumers). to 뒤 '파는 대상'

questions.passage: Have you ever seen rows of identical fruit or vegetables in the supermarket? They may look pretty, but consider this — perfectly fine produce that looks a little different is being wasted. In fact, some farmers end up __________ as much as 50 percent of their harvest because it doesn't look quite right. Fortunately, this is beginning to change. All of this wasted produce tastes just as good as what they sell in the supermarket. So there are now some organizations that buy ugly produce from farmers and sell it to consumers at prices as much as 30 percent lower than normal. Not only does this practice benefit farmers and consumers, but it also helps protect the environment, since farmers don't have to waste resources growing unwanted produce.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: picking up=집어 올리는 / throwing away=버리는 / paying for=값을 치르는 / looking at=바라보는
det.analysis:
① picking up: 수확물의 50%를 '집어 올린다'? 낭비를 지적하는 흐름과 안 맞음
② throwing away: 겉모습이 이상하다는 이유로 수확물의 50%까지 '버린다(throwing away)' ←정답
③ paying for: '값을 치른다'? 문맥 부적절
④ looking at: '바라본다'? 문맥 부적절
det.tip: 겉모습 때문에 수확물을 버림 = throwing away(버리다)

questions.passage: Have you ever seen rows of identical fruit or vegetables in the supermarket? They may look pretty, but consider this — perfectly fine produce that looks a little different is being wasted. In fact, some farmers end up throwing away as much as 50 percent of their harvest because it doesn't look quite right. Fortunately, this is beginning to change. All of this wasted produce tastes just as good as what they sell in the supermarket. So there are now some organizations that buy ugly produce from farmers and sell it to consumers at prices as much as 30 percent lower than normal. Not only does this practice benefit farmers and consumers, but it also helps protect the environment, since farmers don't have to __________ growing unwanted produce.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: save money=돈을 아끼다 / hire workers=일꾼을 고용하다 / buy seeds=씨앗을 사다 / waste resources=자원을 낭비하다
det.analysis:
① save money: 문맥상 환경 보호와 직접 연결되는 것은 자원 낭비를 줄이는 것
② hire workers: 문맥 무관
③ buy seeds: 문맥 무관
④ waste resources: 원치 않는 농산물을 기르느라 '자원을 낭비할(waste resources)' 필요가 없어져 환경 보호에 도움 ←정답
det.tip: don't have to ___ growing unwanted produce → 자원을 낭비하다(waste resources)
